skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Melodiosa
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Melodiosa. Sora's outfit in her time studying and performing at Siracusa's Teatro di Milano. Siracusan musical productions have a unique cultural flair, which in turn calls for accessorizing to match.
skins.quote: Who ever said that pop singers can't grasp vintage classics from distant lands?

skins.name: Summer Flowers FA361
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA361. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
skins.quote: Wherever you are is a live show.
